'''AVI-SPL''' is an American company that provides multi-office collaboration and [[audio-visual|audio video]] technologies as well as managed AV services to businesses and organizations. The company installs equipment related to [[videoconferencing]] and [[telepresence]], digital media systems, audio, [[Physical security|security systems]], [[control room]]s, and provides onsite staffing.

AVI-SPL is headquartered in [[Tampa, Florida]], and as of April 2020, employed 4,300+ people among 69 locations worldwide,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.avnetwork.com/news/scn-top-50-systems-integrators-2023|title=SCN Top 50 Systems Integrators 2023|last=|first=|date=November 2023|website=AV Network|publisher=Future plc|access-date=29 Nov 2023}}</ref> including offices in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Germany and United Arab Emirates, with a local presence in other EMEA, LATAM and APAC countries.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://avispl.com/locations/ |title=Office Locations |publisher=AVI-SPL |access-date=2022-10-27}}</ref>

== History ==
=== Foundations and origins ===
AVI-SPL was formed in 2008 from a merger of ''Audio Visual Innovations, Inc.'' (AVI) and ''Signal Perfection Ltd.'' (SPL).<ref>https://www.svconline.com/news/avi-and-spl-complete-merger-370747</ref> That merger was facilitated by equity financing from the Silver Lake Sumeru investment division of [[Silver Lake Partners]].

''AVI'' was founded by Martin Schaffel in 1979 in [[Lakeland, Florida]].<ref>[http://creativemac.digitalmedianet.com/articles/viewarticle.jsp?id=24570-1 "AV Hall of Fame: Marty Schaffel"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120402195334/http://creativemac.digitalmedianet.com/articles/viewarticle.jsp?id=24570-1 |date=2012-04-02 }}. ''Creative Mac''.</ref>  AVI-SPL began as Audio Visual Innovations in Florida in 1979.<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://avispl.com/about-us/our-people-and-culture/|title=Our People and Culture|website=AVI-SPL Digital Enablement Services Provider}}</ref>

''SPL'' began in Columbia, [[Maryland]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bizjournals.com/tampabay/stories/2008/04/14/daily48.html |title=Audio Visual Innovations merges with Signal Perfection |website=bizjournals.com |date=2008-04-14}}</ref> In 1998, the company was acquired by Production Resource Group (PRG).<ref>[http://www.privco.com/mergers-acquisitions/production-resource-group-llc-acquires-signal-perfection-ltd-august-1998 "Production Resource Group, L.L.C. Acquires Signal Perfection, Ltd. For $6.6 Million"] (August 1998). PrivCo.</ref> SPL designed, integrated and installed collaborative communication systems for a variety of organizations.

Both companies earned recognition in the 2000s. SPL won a number of awards during this period, including the Best AV Projects Award from ARCHI-TECH magazine from 2004 to 2006. Also in 2006, AVI was named by [[NewBay Media|Systems Contractor News]] magazine as the top systems integrator in North America, a year during which it had earnings of $216 million.<ref>[http://www.bizjournals.com/tampabay/stories/2008/04/14/daily48.html "Audio Visual Innovations merges with Signal Perfection"]. (April 18, 2008). ''[[American City Business Journals|Tampa Bay Business Journal]]''.</ref> SPL was named the 2005 “Integrator of the Year” by [[Christie (audiovisual company)|Christie Digital]].

AVI and SPL brought 800 and 400 staff, respectively, to the merger, and as a result, became the largest AV integrator in the United States.<ref>Wells, Melissa (August 2008). [http://www.maddux.com/2008/August/technology.asp "Tech Files: Trend Spotting"] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120425152817/http://www.maddux.com/2008/August/technology.asp |date=April 25, 2012 }}.  ''Tampa Bay's Maddux Business Report''.</ref>

===Growth and acquisitions (2012-23)=== 
In January 2012, AVI-SPL acquired ''Iformata Communications'', a video [[managed services]] specialist company. AVI-SPL purchased both Iformata's Video [[Network Operations Center]] (VNOC) and its VNOC Symphony management platform. Iformata, based in [[Dayton, Ohio]], was founded in 2004.<ref>Berndtson, Chad (January 27, 2012).[http://www.crn.com/news/networking/232500645/video-var-m-a-avi-spl-buys-iformata.htm "Video VAR M&A: AVI-SPL Buys Iformata"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120130064737/http://www.crn.com/news/networking/232500645/video-var-m-a-avi-spl-buys-iformata.htm |date=2012-01-30 }}. ''[[CRN Magazine]]''.</ref>

In September 2016, AVI-SPL founded a new branch office in Germany, AVI-SPL Deutschland GmbH, based in [[Dreieich]] in the [[Frankfurt]] area.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.avinteractive.com/news/avi-spl-to-open-office-in-germany-29-09-2016/|title=AVI-SPL to open office in Germany|website=AV Magazine}}</ref> On November 30, 2016, it acquired Anderson Audio Visual, a systems integration company with offices in California, North Carolina, and Texas.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://avispl.com/new/avi-spl-acquires-anderson-audio-visual/|title=AVI-SPL Acquires Anderson Audio Visual - AVI-SPL|newspaper=AVI-SPL|language=en-US|access-date=2016-12-06|archive-date=2016-12-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161220101525/http://avispl.com/new/avi-spl-acquires-anderson-audio-visual/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On October 4, 2017, the company acquired Sharp's Audio Visual, with 8 offices in 6 Canadian Provinces.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://avispl.com/new/avispl_acquires_sharpsav/|title=AVI-SPL Acquires Sharp's Audio Visual, Becomes First National Provider of AV and Collaboration Technology Solutions in Canada|newspaper=AVI-SPL|language=en-US|access-date=2017-11-11}}</ref> On July 23, 2019, it acquired Digital Video Networks - a top audiovisual (AV) and [[unified communications]] (UC) provider in the southwestern United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.commercialintegrator.com/blogs/avi-spl-acquisition-digital-video-networks-inside-scoop/|title=AVI-SPL Acquisition of Digital Video Networks The Inside Scoop|website=Commercial Integrator}}</ref>

On April 7, 2020, Marlin Equity Partners (Marlin) acquired AVI-SPL and subsequently merged it with Whitlock, an existing Marlin [[portfolio company]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ravepubs.com/its-official-marlin-equity-partners-completes-acquisition-of-avi-spl-so-whitlock-and-avi-spl-are-now-one/|title=It's Official Marlin Equity Partners Completes Acquisition of AVI-SPL, So Whitlock and AVI-SPL Are Now One|website=rave [PUBS]}}</ref>

In December 2021, AVI-SPL acquired SKC Communications, an audio-visual and unified communications provider.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.avnetwork.com/news/avi-spl-to-acquire-skc-communications|title=AVI-SPL to Acquire SKC Communications|website=AVNetwork}}</ref> In February 2022, it acquired Sonics AVI Ltd., an audio-visual integration firm in Dublin, Ireland.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://avispl.com/news/avi-spl-to-acquire-sonics/|title=AVI-SPL to Acquire Sonics|website=AVI-SPL Digital Enablement Services Provider}}</ref>

In January 2023, AVI-SPL acquired AdTech Systems, an audio-visual integration firm operating in New England.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.commercialintegrator.com/business_resources/operations/avi-spl-acquires-adtech-systems/|title=AVI-SPL Acquires Adtech Systems|website=Commercial Integrator}}</ref> Later in January, the company announced the release of a sub-brand AVI-SPL VideoLink, to represent the organisations suite of video services. The brand will focus on enterprise video services.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Magazine |first=A. V. |title=AVI-SPL VideoLink enterprise video sub-brand launched |url=https://www.avinteractive.com/news/business/avi-spl-videolink-enterprise-video-sub-brand-launched-19-01-2023/ |access-date=2023-05-25 |website=AV Magazine |language=en}}</ref> In December 2023, AVI-SPL completed the incorporation of AVI-SPL Japan Private Limited.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.commercialintegrator.com/news/avi-spl-formally-incorporates-in-japan/|title=AVI-SPL Formally Incorporates In Japan|website=Commercial Integrator}}</ref>

===26North Partners LP (2025 - Present)===
On June 25, 2025, 26North Partners LP announced a plan to acquire AVI-SPL.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.commercialintegrator.com/news/26north-partners-to-acquire-avi-spl/142188/|title=26North Partners to Acquire AVI-SPL|last=|first=|date=June 2025|website=Commercial Integrator|access-date=18 Jul 2025}}</ref>On August 13, the company announced that it had completed this transaction.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://avispl.com/news/26north-completes-acquisition-of-global-leader-in-digital-workplace-solutions-avi-spl/|title=26North Completes Acquisition of Global Leader in Digital Workplace Solutions AVI-SPL|work=AVI-SPL|access-date=2025-09-15|language=en}}</ref>

== Products and services ==
AVI-SPL provides audio visual technology for video calls and digital workplace collaboration to support work from anywhere.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://avispl.com/solutions/|title=Digital Workplace Collaboration and Meeting Solutions|website=AVI-SPL}}</ref> AVI-SPL supports staff working in the office and at home. 

AVI-SPL also provides audio visual technology to help companies create immersive experiences.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.avnetwork.com/news/avi-spl-xtg-wins-frost-and-sullivan-2023-best-practices-award|title=AVI-SPL XTG Wins Frost & Sullivan 2023 Best Practices Award|website=AVNetwork}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
* 2022: the company's Middle East unit won the LAVNCH [CODE] 2022 Out of This World award for Museum of the Future.<ref name="ravepubs1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ravepubs.com/2022-rave-readers-choice-awards-winners/|title=Announcing the 2022 rAVe Readers' Choice Awards Winners – rAVe [PUBS]|first=Steph|last=Beckett|website=www.ravepubs.com}}</ref>
* 2022: won the Strategic Account Management Association (SAMA) 2022 Inaugural Systemic Enablement of the SAM Program award and the 2022 Outstanding Mature Program of the Year.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mytechdecisions.com/news-1/avi-spl-strategic-account-management-association-awards/|title=AVI-SPL Awarded by Strategic Account Management Association|website=TechDecisions}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.commercialintegrator.com/news/avi-spl-wins-excellence-awards-by-strategic-account-management-association/|title=AVI-SPL Wins Excellence Awards by Strategic Account Management Association|website=Commercial Integrator}}</ref>
* 2023: the company was recognized as the top systems integrator by Systems Contractor News.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.avnetwork.com/news/scn-top-50-systems-integrators-2023|title=SCN Top 50 Systems Integrators 2023|website=AVNetwork}}</ref>
* 2023: it won Cisco 2023 Reimagine Workspaces Partner of the Year - Americas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.avinteractive.com/territories-news/us-canada/avi-spl-wins-cisco-partner-of-the-year-award-for-americas-01-11-2023/|title=AVI-SPL Wins Cisco Reimagine Workspaces partner award|website=AV Magazine}}</ref>
* 2024: AVI-SPL recognized on CRN 2024 Elite 150 Managed Service Provider List.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.commercialintegrator.com/news/avi-spl-joins-crns-2024-elite-150-msp-list/|title=AVI-SPL Joins CRN's 2024 Elite 150 MSP List|website=Commercial Integrator}}</ref>
* 2024: the company was recognized as the top systems integrator by Systems Contractor News.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.avnetwork.com/news/scn-top-50-systems-integrators-2024|title=SCN Top 50 Systems Integrators 2024|website=AVNetwork}}</ref>

== Associations ==
AVI-SPL is a founding partner of the ''AV Global Alliance'', the company has a worldwide footprint that encompasses 30 countries and currently includes 28 partner companies.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/avm-avi-spl-expand-global-alliance-to-include-video-managed-services-111589179.html|title=AVM, AVI-SPL Expand Global Alliance to Include Video Managed Services|website=PR Newswire}}</ref><ref>[http://www.avmachines.com/news-and-events/news/AV-Global-Alliance-Expands-to-28-Partners "AV Global Alliance Expands to 28 Partners"] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110802210550/http://www.avmachines.com/news-and-events/news/AV-Global-Alliance-Expands-to-28-Partners |date=August 2, 2011 }} (March 2011).</ref>
